input.headline: Check on Mdm Wong Lai Fong, #12-02, now. Lifts are down, take Stairwell A.
steps: Take Stairwell A up to level 12. Do not use the lift.
Knock firmly and call her name. She is hard of hearing, so wave or face her.
Speak in Cantonese or Mandarin. Ask if she is safe and needs help.
If she does not respond or is in danger, call 995 right away.
input.sms: KG: Pls check Mdm Wong Lai Fong #12-02 now. Lifts down, use Stairwell A. She is hard of hearing; speak Cantonese/Mandarin. Reply 1=reached 2=need help
